sup:70110.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

For generations, our foundry has taken great pride in supplying our regional partners with the utmost care and quality. To continue serving you with the craftsmanship you expect from us, we must account for our rising expenses. Over the past twelve months, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost.

Taking these developments into consideration, we are pleased to present our offer for a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

We value our long-standing relationship deeply and look forward to continuing our successful cooperation.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

reply.text:
Guten Tag,

It is always a pleasure to reflect on the long-standing relationship our foundry has shared with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH over the years. We take immense pride in the craftsmanship of our people and the high-quality castings we deliver from our region.

Regarding our current Angebot, we are offering a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. Please keep in mind that this offer stays valid for 30 days.

Without movement from your side we cannot move either. We value our partnership deeply and hope we can find a good way forward together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

move.subject: Re: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
move.body:
Dear Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG team,

You have reminded us more than once that you held the old price to support our partnership; it sounds like you want that support to work both ways. We value that commitment and want to recognise genuine cost pressures through a transparent, sustainable adjustment. How could faster payment help us agree a price adjustment grounded in the verified cost drivers?

We confirm a binding volume of 8,150 units per year for 12 months. Using your own cost shares (LCI-C 30%, PPI-C241 24%) and the latest six-month index moves (LCI-C +1.7%, PPI-C241 +6.2%), your cost increase comes to about +2.0% of the price, not +9.5%. Straight talk: over the last 12 months we paid 86% of your invoices late, on average 3 days after the due date. That is on us, and it ends with this contract: every invoice paid on the due date, which brings your cash in about 3 days earlier than you are used to.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 127.31 per unit, from 2027-01-01, 14 days payment). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your commitment to 14-day payment terms and the binding volume, which allows us to adjust our position. Please note that our cost increases must be measured over the full 12-month period, not just six months, to reflect the true impact on our foundry. In recognition of the improved payment terms and your transparent approach, we can offer a price of €136.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 January 2027. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. 

Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

move.body:
Dear Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG team,

It sounds like faster payment has given you room to move, while a full-year view of costs remains essential to a fair agreement. We appreciate that flexibility and want to honour our long-standing partnership with a transparent basis for the adjustment. How should we reconcile the annual decline in electricity producer prices with the cost pressures your foundry is experiencing?

We confirm a binding volume of 8,150 units per year for 12 months. Using your own cost shares (LCI-C 30%, PPI-C241 24%) and the latest six-month index moves (LCI-C +1.7%, PPI-C241 +6.2%), your cost increase comes to about +2.0% of the price, not +9.5%.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 128.04 per unit, from 2027-01-01, 14 days payment). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We note your slight adjustment, but your six-month calculation continues to ignore the full twelve-month reality of our cost increases. Regarding electricity, our foundry secures energy through long-term contracts to guarantee supply stability, meaning short-term market declines do not reduce our current burden; please share the specific data you are using. Furthermore, our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

In the spirit of our long-standing partnership, we can make a further step to a price of €135.90 per unit, keeping the Zahlungsziel 14 days net and the valid from 1 January 2027 start date. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

move.subject: Re: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
move.body:
Dear Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG team,

It sounds like the energy contracts that protect your supply stability also prevent falling market prices from easing your current costs. We value our long-standing partnership and are sharing the electricity index as context, not as a measure of your contracted costs or a request to disclose your calculation. How can payment certainty and the timing of an adjustment help us reach a fair price that supports stability for both businesses?

We confirm a binding volume of 8,150 units per year for 12 months. Using your own cost shares (LCI-C 30%, PPI-C241 24%) and the latest six-month index moves (LCI-C +1.7%, PPI-C241 +6.2%), your cost increase comes to about +2.0% of the price, not +9.5%. That supports a price of about EUR 129.06. What is the lowest price at which you can sign these terms today?

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 128.94 per unit, from 2027-01-01, 14 days payment). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Guten Tag,

It is always a pleasure to build upon the long relationship between our companies, and we appreciate your further step and the value of payment certainty, which we have already recognized by accepting the 14-day terms and the January 2027 start date. 

However, we must insist on the full twelve-month view of our cost increases, as a six-month snapshot does not reflect the reality of our foundry's burden. While we do not disclose our internal limits, we are prepared to make a further concession to €135.40 per unit to help us conclude this agreement. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal, and our margin and our limits stay internal. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our Angebot provides a price of €135.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 January 2027. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. This offer stays valid for 7 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

Our standard Zahlungsziel is … days net.
Our margin and our limits stay internal.
Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.
